game.title: SoulCalibur VI
game.blurb: 3D weapon-based fighting game from Bandai Namco (RAWG lists Bandai Namco Entertainment, its American arm and NAMCO), released 2018-10-19. RAWG average playtime: 3 hours. Genres: Action, Fighting. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Story Milestones
chapters.summary: Hidden achievements, most likely story progress in the Soul Chronicle and Libra of Soul modes. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Libra of Soul
chapters.summary: Secondary missions, mercenaries, food, weapons and upgrades, towns, Ancients and Astral Fissure missions.

chapters.title: Arcade and Training
chapters.summary: Clearing Arcade mode, a gold rating, and matchmaking from Training mode.

chapters.title: Online Battles
chapters.summary: Ranked and casual matches, online battle counts and fighting with a created character.

chapters.title: Battle Techniques
chapters.summary: Perfect victories, critical edges, lethal hits, guard impacts, reversal edges, ring outs and character moves.

chapters.title: Museum and Full Completion
chapters.summary: Unlocking Museum entries with Soul Points, and the all-achievements award.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 544750)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Soulcalibur_VI
Fandom (soulcalibur.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://soulcalibur.fandom.com/wiki/Soulcalibur_VI
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). The Steam schema calls app 544750 "LUXOR" (an internal codename); the store list confirms it as "SOULCALIBUR VI". StrategyWiki has "Soulcalibur VI" (completion stage 0); only its Achievements and trophies, Moves and Table of Contents subpages are written, and Walkthrough and Gameplay are linked but not written, so nothing was used. soulcalibur.fandom.com has "Soulcalibur VI" (the "SoulCalibur VI" spelling is missing) with about 185 linked pages, including "Soul Chronicle" and "Libra of Soul", which are the only source for those mode names; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 14 of 49 Steam achievements are hidden and sit in the story chapter, including "Glory Beckons" (4.5%), "Globetrotter" (2.9%) and "Bull in a China Shop" (16.4%), which may not be story at all. Character Creation is named in only one online achievement, so it has no chapter of its own.
